mechanisms.summary: Lévy generator, even cumulants, Berezin kernel/multiplier, and Gaussian limits

mechanisms.summary: q coproduct, finite multiplicity frames, and q recoupling

mechanisms.section: Tree overlaps, loop closure, and compilation
mechanisms.summary: Coupling-tree bases, finite pentagon closure, and Givens compilation
boundaries: Closure of complete basis overlaps does not authenticate a universal category-level associator.

mechanisms.section: Scalar bridge and its remaining comparison; correction C11
mechanisms.summary: Exact terminating scalar Racah and q-Racah sums
boundaries: Nonzero denominators of retained terms are checked before cancellation.

No full matrix recoupling identification.

mechanisms.section: Appendix E; feedback_odd_derivatives
mechanisms.summary: Exact scalar multi-channel and asymmetric feedback derivative arrays
boundaries: Arbitrary rational parameters are formal data.
Empty channels give F=z.

mechanisms.section: Appendix E; sections, phase lanes, taps and Hurwitz product
mechanisms.summary: Finite derivative arrays pass through existing residue, polyphase/tap, and binomial-product machinery
boundaries: Insert zero even entries before phase decomposition.
Ordinary taps differ from binomial EGF multiplication.

mechanisms.section: Theorem 1; compact continuity; resolution atlas RA-3
mechanisms.summary: Global feedback type constants and sufficient separating radius
boundaries: Compact weak-tap bound is implemented exactly.
General transcendental lower/upper type constants and sufficient-radius evaluation remain in the source proof/laboratory.
A sufficient radius is not an optimal first-visible radius.

mechanisms.section: Theorems AI-1/AI-2; ordered atom extraction and character resolution
mechanisms.summary: Arithmetic germ inverse and conditional negative-depth extraction
boundaries: Exact uniqueness from the full germ is not stable finite precision recovery.
No generic arithmetic atom extraction API is integrated.

mechanisms.section: RA-4/RA-5; integer disk and derivative bounds
mechanisms.summary: Exact excluded-prime rational disk envelope
boundaries: Specialized to a=beta=2 and integer nonnegative R,k.
Prime must be validated; no infinite sum is truncated.
Negativedepth crossing/cancellation displays remain source formulas.

mechanisms.section: Theorems 1–3; multiplicative sieve strengths
mechanisms.summary: All-prime multiplicative positivity domain and generalized definite-pencil fibers
boundaries: Implemented atlas subset has one negative prime shelf and unit strengths elsewhere.
General finite-prime strength polynomials and generalized eigenvalue fibers remain external research machinery.
Passing a finite Hankel test does not certify the true all-prime positivity domain.

mechanisms.section: Interpolation controls the whole polynomial space; RA low-degree certificate
mechanisms.summary: Exact Lagrange constant and sufficient positivity of every polynomial through the selected degree
boundaries: Distinct positive prime-free squarefree labels.
Strictly positive margin certifies positivity; zero/negative margins are inconclusive.
At delta=1e-12, degree<=4 is certified; degrees5 and6 are undecided.

mechanisms.section: Tailored detector bound; initial-segment correction
mechanisms.summary: Normalized rational detector and rigorous entire positive-tail upper bound
boundaries: Killed labels must be the complete ordered initial segment.
Only upper_bound<0 detects negativity.
Degree7 witness does not prove minimal detecting degree.

mechanisms.section: Mellin representation, meromorphic continuation, trace zeros, and regularized product
mechanisms.summary: Orbit spectral-zeta analytic continuation and exact special values
boundaries: The generic finite sequence and zero APIs do not implement this continuation.
No branch-sensitive infinite spectral sum is approximated as an exact continuation.

mechanisms.section: Appendix J; coupled_odd_derivatives
mechanisms.summary: Labeled coupled exact derivative arrays and denominator clearing
boundaries: Strict rational inputs.
Derivatives and ordinary Taylor coefficients use different factorial normalizations.
Clearing factor is sufficient, not necessarily minimal.
Formal parameters outside contractions carry no analytic guarantee.

mechanisms.section: Appendix J.3; disk_majorant and certified_evaluation
mechanisms.summary: Exact disk majorant and real rational enclosures with uniform complex tail bound
boundaries: All four scales lie in (0,1).
Real x>=0 and outer S>x.
Bounds are rational; float conversion is not a directed enclosure.
Resource exhaustion raises.

mechanisms.section: Characteristic exponent and positive Perron vector; Theorems2/3
mechanisms.summary: Exact characteristic identity and Perron proportions at integer-order anchors
boundaries: Verifies supplied positive integer exponent exactly.
General real-order solver and global type constants remain in the source.
Ordinary type-limit existence is open.

mechanisms.section: Section1 exact component rescaling classification
mechanisms.summary: Exact discriminant for two reduction surfaces
boundaries: Positive strict contraction domain.
Zero set is q=b or qb=ar.
Scalar reduction of a particular solution is distinct from operator decoupling.

mechanisms.section: recover_squared_scales/recover_rational_scales; Appendix I
mechanisms.summary: Exact labeled coefficient inverse through degree seven
boundaries: D!=0 required.
Six ordinary coefficients are exact rationals.
Implemented domain has rational quadratic candidates; rational-scale wrapper also needs rational roots.
Inconsistent jets and noisy perturbations rejected.
No uniform finite-precision stability claim near reduction.

mechanisms.section: RA-1/RA-2; exact unit-disk error certificate
mechanisms.summary: Exact weak-feedback compact envelope with rational omitted-tail bound
boundaries: 0<=epsilon<=1 and rational0<=R<=1.
Finite index must satisfy the monotone-tail guard.
Compact closeness does not preserve the global entire order.

mechanisms.section: Resource-guarded exact laboratory
mechanisms.summary: Explicit finite resource budgets across production exact machinery
boundaries: No silent truncation.
Conservative limits are not a uniform wall-clock or memory guarantee.
Derived interpolation threshold and later margin inputs/outputs retain the builder bit budget.
